author: gta6tracker
text:
Rockstar says GTA 6 is an “extremely tough game to show off” because there are “so many cool things” happening throughout the game.

Rockstar North’s Rob Nelson reportedly explained that GTA 6 “kind of has everything,” making it difficult to showcase everything players can experience in a single trailer or presentation.

And there’s still plenty more to see. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick previously described the GTA 6 Extended Look as just “one of the hors d’oeuvres,” adding that the “appetizers, main course and dessert” are still to follow before launch.

GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026.

author: gta6plus
text:
A 24/7 Vice City livestream would be Rockstar’s biggest flex or its biggest risk.

Four fixed cameras. No commentary. No carefully selected trailer shots. Just GTA 6’s traffic, weather, police and NPCs running continuously.

Fans would find incredible unscripted moments. They’d also find every repeated animation and broken traffic pattern.

Would Rockstar ever be confident enough to let us watch?

Concept by u/Capital-Ad576 on Reddit.
